interpretations.c3_candidate: a strict Tier-A C1 service lineage before U recovery
interpretations.candidate_dimensions: all assessment identifiers emitted by the pinned evaluator and archived in security_assessment_schema.json
interpretations.pilot_order: ascending SHA-256 of namespace, NUL, canonical_upstream_id
interpretations.pilot_project_identity: normalized authoritative upstream URL from package metadata
interpretations.repository_state: downloaded signed/repository metadata bytes plus artifact identifiers and hashes; no later metadata refresh
interpretations.tier_a_ambiguity: any competing candidate at the same or stronger mode rejects the mapping
interpretations.usable_dimension_resolved_u: at least one assessment dimension has PRESENT_RESOLVED or ABSENT_RESOLVED U status
